semantic_review: Explicit per-record resource attribution, objective inference, pre-kill witness and confidence review are recorded in v6_repair_changes.json. Structural checks verify preservation and exclusion coverage; they do not independently establish visual facts.
limitations: Visual interpretation of sampled local footage: preparation/inactive checks at approximately 4 seconds, active combat UI/full-scene frames at 1 second, selected decisive windows at 0.5 seconds with full-frame checks where needed. Not every control or defensive event was independently checked at half-second cadence. Times approximate due to sampling. No combat log, audio transcription or matchup-wide synthesis.
